svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-programmatic-production-and-indexing; chapter number: 4; title: Programmatic Production Beside Indexing Outcomes; subtitle: Matt Diggity ([4DgWUgtZGqQ @ 00:00:14]; [4DgWUgtZGqQ @ 00:09:16]) reports the client case; B2BSEOio ([uI61LP8Ue30 @ 00:01:19]) reports the healthcare account's indexing counts.; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: Separate case measures, not additive buckets or a combined total; note: The required comparison format holds independent observations, not parts of one stack. Equal low and high values encode reported points, not estimated ranges; 1,700 encodes only the stated lower threshold for 'over 1,700.' Matt Diggity ([4DgWUgtZGqQ @ 00:04:06]) emphasizes input inspection and internal-link opportunities; B2BSEOio ([uI61LP8Ue30 @ 00:04:09]) attributes the healthcare failure to largely untouched, repetitive AI pages.; buckets: label: Client Articles Produced; low: 502; high: 502; notes: 502 articles generated without AI in the reported agency case. [Matt Diggity — 4DgWUgtZGqQ @ 00:00:14]; label: Client Top-Ten Keywords; low: 1923; high: 1923; notes: Reported endpoint of 1,923 top-ten keywords, up from 0; this counts keywords, not articles. [Matt Diggity — 4DgWUgtZGqQ @ 00:09:16]; label: Healthcare Pages Outside Index; low: 1700; high: 1700; notes: Over 1,700 pages were outside the index. The numeric fields preserve the threshold, not an exact count or an upper bound. [B2BSEOio — uI61LP8Ue30 @ 00:01:19]; label: Healthcare Indexed Pages; low: 400; high: 400; notes: 400 indexed pages in the displayed healthcare Search Console account.
